title: Untitled (Polaroid on a kitchen table)
service: Hugging Face Space Tongyi-MAI/Z-Image-Turbo, anonymous Gradio API (no account)
prompt: An old faded Polaroid SX-70 instant photograph lying on a wooden table, the square print with its white border, inside the print a soft hazy summer afternoon view from Brighton beach of the ruined West Pier at Brighton, a skeletal blackened rusted iron pavilion frame with curved roof ribs and no roof, standing alone out in the sea on thin iron legs, not connected to the shore, warm washed-out colours, slight colour shift, realistic
settings: resolution 1024x1024, seed 7, 9 steps, shift 3.0; native output 1024x1024, stored as JPEG q92
terms_note: Model and Space are both Apache 2.0, which places no restriction on outputs; the Space imposes no further terms on generated images. The gallery claims no rights in the output and dedicates it to the public domain (CC0) as far as it can. Fabricated photograph: nothing in it was ever photographed.
note: The prompt was written by the curator, an AI. Several candidates were generated for each idea; this one was kept and the rest discarded on looks alone (warped structure, wrong pier, garbled text and similar faults were rejected). The image is shown unedited apart from resizing for the web.
